crc_image_desc_t

Image description and expected values used by crc_api_validate().

Fields
image

Image bytes to validate. May be NULL only when actual_size is zero.

actual_size

Number of bytes present in image.

expected_size

Required image size used for the size check.

max_size

Optional upper size limit; zero disables this limit.

channel

Value passed to the CRC calculation context; its meaning is defined by the CRC driver.

expected_crc

CRC value that the calculated checksum must match.
